node.title: Rank-eleven order-32 common-support cancellation
node.closure: exact support-wise shortening adapter preserving the critical order
node.statement: Let the 32 actual records emitted by the rank-eleven heavy-pair seed compiler have exact common support C of size c<K-4922. Interpolate the two received columns on C, subtract that codeword line, divide every explanation difference by the locator of C, and puncture C. This gives 32 support-wise MCA-bad records with the same slopes and chronology in RS[F,D\C,K-c] at agreement m-c; their exact supports have empty common intersection. Both n-K=1048576 and m-K=67472 are unchanged, K-c>=4923, and the critical order remains floor(2(n-K)/(m-K))+1=32. The residual slope-degree floor ranges from 3 to 18 and reaches 18 only when K-c>=1044446, equivalently c<=4130. The deployed partial-relative theorem is not automatically puncture-uniform, so classification/payment of this output remains open.
